summary: Pixel waveform player that fills as it plays, previews ahead of the playhead on hover and ripples from wherever you click.

events.name: pause
events.description: Fires when playback pauses, including when the track reaches the end.

methods.description: Starts or pauses playback and fires `play` or `pause`. Playing at the end starts over.
Moves the playhead to a position from 0 to 1 of the track. A value that is not a finite number is ignored.

keyboard.action: Seek forward or back by 5 seconds.
Seek to the start or the end.

accessibility: The play button is a native button whose `aria-label` switches between "Play" and "Pause".
The waveform canvas is focusable with `role="slider"`, `aria-label="Seek"`, `aria-valuemin="0"` and `aria-valuemax="222"` (seconds).
`aria-valuenow` is the position in seconds and `aria-valuetext` reads like "1:11 / 3:42". The hover time tooltip is pointer-only.
motion: With reduced motion, the bars around the playhead stop pulsing during playback; click ripples still play.
notes: The track is demo content: "Night Drive", 3:42 long, with a generated waveform and no audio. There is no attribute for a source. Playback starts at 32%.

data.note: The track, its length and its waveform are invented and no audio plays; nothing can be set.
